biological_interpretation: Short sequences have high statistical probabilities of matching by chance in broad databases, leading to higher E-values under standard BLOSUM62. Searching with PAM30 and an elevated E-value threshold successfully retrieves exact crystallographic matches against human beta-globin N-terminal motifs (PDB 1A3N, 4HHB). This confirms the sensitivity of BLAST+ under adjusted scoring matrices for peptide fragment matching.
